287	// collectTagIndices returns every tag column index in input, in input
288	// schema order, except those in exclude. When the schema has no RoleTag
289	// columns at all (synthetic unit-test fixtures that pre-date the storage
290	// bridge), fall back to keyIndices so the operator still produces the
291	// keys-only output those tests expect. Production paths always have
292	// RoleTag columns because BuildBatchSchema emits one per projected tag.
293	func collectTagIndices(input *vectorized.BatchSchema, keyIndices []int, exclude map[int]struct{}) []int {
294		hasTagCols := false
295		out := make([]int, 0, len(input.Columns))
296		for i, def := range input.Columns {
297			if def.Role != vectorized.RoleTag {
298				continue
299			}
300			hasTagCols = true
301			if _, skip := exclude[i]; skip {
302				continue
303			}
304			out = append(out, i)
305		}
306		if !hasTagCols {
307			return slices.Clone(keyIndices)
308		}
309		return out
310	}

312	// hiddenTagExclusionSet collects the input-schema column index of every
313	// AggSpec whose HideTag is set — the tag column it targets should not also
314	// be carried forward as a first-seen tag (design §5.2). Returns nil when no
315	// spec hides its tag.
316	func hiddenTagExclusionSet(aggs []AggSpec) map[int]struct{} {
317		var excl map[int]struct{}
318		for _, spec := range aggs {
319			if !spec.HideTag {
320				continue
321			}
322			if excl == nil {
323				excl = make(map[int]struct{}, 1)
324			}
325			excl[spec.InputCol] = struct{}{}
326		}
327		return excl
328	}

330	// Init prepares the group map. It does NOT validate the mode — mode rejection
331	// happens at the per-method level (Consume/Finalize/NextBatch) so the
332	// dispatcher matches the spec's distributed forward-compat language. For
333	// AggModeReduce, Init also resets the (shard, group_key) replica-dedup map
334	// so the operator can be reused across distributed reduce runs without a
335	// fresh allocation per call.
336	func (a *BatchAggregation) Init(ctx context.Context) error {
337		a.groups = make(map[string]*aggGroup)
338		if a.mode == AggModeReduce {
339			a.dedupSeen = make(map[string]struct{})
340		}
341		tracer := query.GetTracer(ctx)
342		if tracer != nil {
343			var spanName string
344			switch a.mode {
345			case AggModeAll:
346				spanName = "groupby-agg-all"
347			case AggModeMap:
348				spanName = "groupby-agg-map"
349			case AggModeReduce:
350				spanName = "groupby-agg-reduce"
351			}
352			a.span, _ = tracer.StartSpan(ctx, "%s", spanName)
353		}
354		return nil
355	}

357	// OutputSchema returns the schema of emitted batches: key columns followed by
358	// agg output columns.
359	func (a *BatchAggregation) OutputSchema() *vectorized.BatchSchema { return a.outputSchema }

361	// Consume folds every active row into its group's accumulator. Null values are
362	// excluded from aggregation (count not incremented; sum/min/max unchanged).
363	//
364	// Each new group reserves entrySize bytes from the shared MemoryTracker. If
365	// the budget is exhausted, Consume returns the wrapped tracker error and the
366	// row's group is not added — partial-batch state is consistent.
367	//
368	// AggModeAll and AggModeMap share the per-row fold path; they diverge only at
369	// emit time (NextBatch). AggModeReduce uses a parallel combinePartial path:
370	// each input row is one (shard, group) partial; replica duplicates (same
371	// shard + same group_key) are dropped via dedupSeen, then the Partial is
372	// Combine'd into the group's Reduce accumulator. Cross-shard rows that share
373	// a group_key are KEPT and combined, matching the row path's
374	// deduplicateAggregatedDataPointsWithShard semantics.
375	func (a *BatchAggregation) Consume(_ context.Context, b *vectorized.RecordBatch) error {
376		if a.mode != AggModeAll && a.mode != AggModeMap && a.mode != AggModeReduce {
377			return ErrAggModeNotImplemented
378		}
379		active, activeErr := activeIndices(b)
380		if activeErr != nil {
381			return activeErr
382		}
383		if a.span != nil {
384			a.rowsIn += int64(len(active))
385		}
386		for _, rowIdx := range active {
387			key := a.computeKey(b, int(rowIdx))
388			if a.mode == AggModeReduce && a.markDedupSeen(b, int(rowIdx), key) {
389				// markDedupSeen returns true ⇒ this (shard, group_key) pair
390				// already arrived from a replica of the same shard; skip the
391				// row so it does not double-count.
392				continue
393			}
394			group, exists := a.groups[key]
395			if !exists {
396				if a.entrySize > 0 {
397					if reserveErr := a.tracker.Reserve(a.entrySize); reserveErr != nil {
398						return fmt.Errorf("aggregation memory budget exceeded: %w", reserveErr)
399					}
400					a.reserved += a.entrySize
401				}
402				newGroup, newErr := a.newGroup(b, int(rowIdx), key)
403				if newErr != nil {
404					return newErr
405				}
406				a.groups[key] = newGroup
407				a.insertion = append(a.insertion, newGroup)
408				group = newGroup
409			}
410			for slotIdx, spec := range a.aggs {
411				if a.mode == AggModeReduce {
412					a.combinePartial(b, int(rowIdx), &group.slots[slotIdx], spec, a.aggInputCountIdx[slotIdx])
413					continue
414				}
415				if foldErr := a.fold(b, int(rowIdx), &group.slots[slotIdx], spec); foldErr != nil {
416					return foldErr
417				}
418			}
419		}
420		return nil
421	}

423	// Finalize is a no-op for AggModeAll, AggModeMap, and AggModeReduce —
424	// Consume eagerly maintains every group's accumulator state (Map or
425	// Reduce), so there is no batched flush step.
426	func (a *BatchAggregation) Finalize(_ context.Context) error {
427		if a.mode != AggModeAll && a.mode != AggModeMap && a.mode != AggModeReduce {
428			return ErrAggModeNotImplemented
429		}
430		return nil
431	}

433	// NextBatch emits one row per group in group-insertion order, paginated by
434	// batchSize. AggModeAll emits final values; AggModeMap emits typed-column
435	// partial state plus a leading shard-id column (see AggMode docs).
436	// AggModeReduce emits the same shape as AggModeAll — tags + final reduced
437	// value — but draws the value from aggregation.Reduce[N].Val() so MEAN
438	// finalization (sum÷count) happens inside the reducer.
439	func (a *BatchAggregation) NextBatch(_ context.Context) (*vectorized.RecordBatch, error) {
440		if a.mode != AggModeAll && a.mode != AggModeMap && a.mode != AggModeReduce {
441			return nil, ErrAggModeNotImplemented
442		}
443		if a.cursor >= len(a.insertion) {
444			return nil, nil
445		}
446		out := a.pool.Get()
447		for out.Len < a.batchSize && a.cursor < len(a.insertion) {
448			group := a.insertion[a.cursor]
449			a.emitGroupRow(out, group)
450			out.Len++
451			a.cursor++
452			if a.span != nil {
453				a.rowsOut++
454			}
455		}
456		if out.Len == 0 {
457			a.pool.Put(out)
458			return nil, nil
459		}
460		return out, nil
461	}

463	// SortInsertionByBucket stable-sorts emission order by each group's
464	// captured bucket timestamp (aggGroup.timeValue, design §7.2), ascending.
465	// A no-op when this aggregation carries no bucket key (bucketIdx < 0).
466	//
467	// This exists for BatchTimeBucket's map-mode drain: its single persistent
468	// aggregator accumulates groups across the whole scan in first-seen order,
469	// but map mode exists precisely because the input may not be
470	// time-ordered — so emission order needs an explicit sort to satisfy the
471	// bucket-ascending output contract (design §7.5). Calling this on a
472	// streaming-mode instance is also safe but a no-op in effect: each such
473	// instance covers exactly one bucket, so every group already shares the
474	// same timeValue and the stable sort leaves insertion order untouched.
475	func (a *BatchAggregation) SortInsertionByBucket() {
476		if a.bucketIdx < 0 {
477			return
478		}
479		slices.SortStableFunc(a.insertion, func(x, y *aggGroup) int {
480			switch {
481			case x.timeValue < y.timeValue:
482				return -1
483			case x.timeValue > y.timeValue:
484				return 1
485			default:
486				return 0
487			}
488		})
489	}

491	// Close releases the group map and refunds the outstanding memory
492	// reservation. Idempotent.
493	func (a *BatchAggregation) Close() error {
494		if a.closed {
495			return nil
496		}
497		a.closed = true
498		memoryChargedBytes := a.reserved
499		if a.reserved > 0 {
500			a.tracker.Release(a.reserved)
501			a.reserved = 0
502		}
503		if a.span != nil {
504			var mode string
505			switch a.mode {
506			case AggModeAll:
507				mode = "all"
508			case AggModeMap:
509				mode = "map"
510			case AggModeReduce:
511				mode = "reduce"
512			}
513			a.span.Tag(tracelabels.TagMode, mode)
514			a.span.Tagf(tracelabels.TagRowsIn, "%d", a.rowsIn)
515			a.span.Tagf(tracelabels.TagRowsOut, "%d", a.rowsOut)
516			a.span.Tagf(tracelabels.TagGroupsOut, "%d", len(a.insertion))
517			a.span.Tagf(tracelabels.TagMemoryChargedBytes, "%d", memoryChargedBytes)
518			if a.mode == AggModeMap {
519				a.span.Tag(tracelabels.TagAggValuePath, string(a.aggValuePath))
520			}
521			a.span.Stop()
522		}
523		a.groups = nil
524		a.insertion = nil
525		return nil
526	}

528	func (a *BatchAggregation) newGroup(b *vectorized.RecordBatch, rowIdx int, key string) (*aggGroup, error) {
529		tagCols := make([]vectorized.Column, len(a.tagIndices))
530		for i, tIdx := range a.tagIndices {
531			tagCols[i] = vectorized.NewColumnForType(a.inputSchema.Columns[tIdx].Type, 1)
532			copyOneValue(tagCols[i], b.Columns[tIdx], rowIdx)
533		}
534		slots := make([]aggSlot, len(a.aggs))
535		for i, spec := range a.aggs {
536			inputDef := a.inputSchema.Columns[spec.InputCol]
537			inputIsFloat := inputDef.Type == vectorized.ColumnTypeFloat64
538			isTagTarget := inputDef.Role == vectorized.RoleTag
539			slot, slotErr := newAggSlot(spec.Func, inputIsFloat, isTagTarget, a.mode)
540			if slotErr != nil {
541				return nil, slotErr
542			}
543			slots[i] = slot
544		}
545		g := &aggGroup{key: key, tagCols: tagCols, slots: slots}
546		// Capture the first-fed-idp's shard for AggModeMap on grouped agg, mirroring
547		// the row path's incidental rule at measure_plan_aggregation.go:285 (the
548		// G9f.2.a semantic-repro requirement). Scalar reduce (len(keyIndices)==0)
549		// leaves shardID at zero — matching the row path's aggAllIterator.Current()
550		// hardcoding ShardId: 0 at :364. AggModeAll never reads the field.
551		if a.mode == AggModeMap && a.shardIDIdx >= 0 && len(a.keyIndices) > 0 {
552			if shardCol, ok := b.Columns[a.shardIDIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]); ok {
553				data := shardCol.Data()
554				if rowIdx >= 0 && rowIdx < len(data) {
555					g.shardID = data[rowIdx]
556				}
557			}
558		}
559		// Capture the bucket start for a time-bucketed group (design §7.2). Every
560		// row in the group shares the same value by construction — the bucket is
561		// itself part of keyIndices — so the creating row's value is definitive.
562		if a.bucketIdx >= 0 {
563			if tsCol, ok := b.Columns[a.bucketIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]); ok {
564				data := tsCol.Data()
565				if rowIdx >= 0 && rowIdx < len(data) {
566					g.timeValue = data[rowIdx]
567				}
568			}
569		}
570		return g, nil
571	}

573	// distinctEntryOverhead estimates the per-value bookkeeping cost of one new
574	// entry in a Distinct's backing map[string]struct{} (string header + hash
575	// bucket slot), on top of the encoded key's own byte length. A rough,
576	// deliberately generous constant — like aggEntrySize's per-group estimate,
577	// it only needs to fail the budget before an actual OOM, not be exact.
578	const distinctEntryOverhead int64 = 48
579	
580	// fold delegates one row's value to the slot's underlying aggregation.Map,
581	// or to foldDistinct for AggCountDistinct. Nulls are skipped — neither the
582	// count nor the running min/max/sum/distinct-set is touched.
583	//
584	// COUNT over a non-numeric column (string/bytes tag, design §6) must not
585	// read the value at all — there is nothing to parse, and countFunc.In
586	// ignores its argument regardless (pkg/query/aggregation/function.go), so a
587	// dummy 0 is enough to advance the count. COUNT_DISTINCT is different: it
588	// must actually read the value (to hash it), so it cannot share this
589	// early-return branch.
590	func (a *BatchAggregation) fold(b *vectorized.RecordBatch, rowIdx int, slot *aggSlot, spec AggSpec) error {
591		col := b.Columns[spec.InputCol]
592		if col.IsNull(rowIdx) {
593			return nil
594		}
595		if spec.Func == AggCountDistinct {
596			return a.foldDistinct(col, rowIdx, slot)
597		}
598		colType := a.inputSchema.Columns[spec.InputCol].Type
599		if spec.Func == AggCount && colType != vectorized.ColumnTypeInt64 && colType != vectorized.ColumnTypeFloat64 {
600			slot.intMap.In(0)
601			return nil
602		}
603		if slot.intMap != nil {
604			var v int64
605			if slot.inputIsFloat {
606				v = int64(col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[float64]).Data()[rowIdx])
607			} else {
608				v = col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Data()[rowIdx]
609			}
610			slot.intMap.In(v)
611			return nil
612		}
613		var v float64
614		if slot.inputIsFloat {
615			v = col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[float64]).Data()[rowIdx]
616		} else {
617			v = float64(col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Data()[rowIdx])
618		}
619		slot.floatMap.In(v)
620		return nil
621	}
622	
623	// foldDistinct encodes col's value at rowIdx with appendKeyComponent (the
624	// same per-type byte encoder BatchAggregation's own group key already
625	// uses — it already covers every target type the §6 semantics matrix
626	// admits) and inserts it into slot's distinct set. Unlike the fixed-size
627	// numeric slots, a distinct set grows with cardinality (design §7.6), so
628	// memory is charged per newly-added value here, not once per group in
629	// Consume — refunded together with every other charge this operator holds
630	// via the shared a.reserved counter in Close.
631	//
632	// Contains is checked (not In) before reserving: In mutates the set
633	// unconditionally, so calling it first would insert a rejected value into
634	// the set before its reservation is known to succeed, leaving that value
635	// resident — and uncharged — in memory even though the budget guard
636	// rejected it. In is only called once the reservation for a genuinely new
637	// key has actually succeeded.
638	func (a *BatchAggregation) foldDistinct(col vectorized.Column, rowIdx int, slot *aggSlot) error {
639		var sb [64]byte
640		encoded := appendKeyComponent(sb[:0], col, rowIdx)
641		if slot.distinct.Contains(encoded) {
642			return nil
643		}
644		charge := int64(len(encoded)) + distinctEntryOverhead
645		if reserveErr := a.tracker.Reserve(charge); reserveErr != nil {
646			return fmt.Errorf("aggregation memory budget exceeded: %w", reserveErr)
647		}
648		a.reserved += charge
649		slot.distinct.In(encoded)
650		return nil
651	}

653	func (a *BatchAggregation) emitGroupRow(out *vectorized.RecordBatch, group *aggGroup) {
654		// Optional leading RoleShardID column (AggModeMap only). outputShardIdx is
655		// -1 in AggModeAll, 0 in AggModeMap (see buildAggOutputLayout).
656		if a.outputShardIdx >= 0 {
657			out.Columns[a.outputShardIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(group.shardID)
658		}
659		// Conditional D2 reversal (design §7.2): re-emit the bucket start as a
660		// RoleTimestamp column, present only when this aggregation is bucketed.
661		if a.outputTimeIdx >= 0 {
662			out.Columns[a.outputTimeIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(group.timeValue)
663		}
664		// Projected tag columns, in tagIndices order — including non-key tags
665		// carried forward as the first-seen value. tagOutOffset is 0 in
666		// AggModeAll and 1 in AggModeMap (after the shard-id column).
667		for i := range a.tagIndices {
668			copyOneValue(out.Columns[a.tagOutOffset+i], group.tagCols[i], 0)
669		}
670		// Agg output columns. AggModeAll emits one Val() per slot; AggModeMap
671		// emits Partial().Value plus a sidecar Partial().Count for MEAN (per
672		// aggHasCount); AggModeReduce emits one Reduce.Val() per slot — same
673		// shape as AggModeAll. Offsets are precomputed in aggOutOffsets so the
674		// emit loop does no per-row schema walking.
675		for slotIdx := range a.aggs {
676			slot := &group.slots[slotIdx]
677			valueIdx := a.aggOutOffsets[slotIdx]
678			switch a.mode {
679			case AggModeMap:
680				countIdx := -1
681				if a.aggHasCount[slotIdx] {
682					countIdx = valueIdx + 1
683				}
684				slot.writePartial(out, valueIdx, countIdx)
685			case AggModeReduce:
686				slot.writeReduce(out.Columns[valueIdx])
687			default:
688				slot.write(out.Columns[valueIdx])
689			}
690		}
691	}

704	// newAggSlot builds the accumulator for the (function, input type, target
705	// kind, mode) tuple. AggModeAll / AggModeMap allocate an aggregation.Map (raw
706	// fold + optional Partial export); AggModeReduce allocates an
707	// aggregation.Reduce (Combine partials + final Val). The numeric type
708	// mirrors aggOutputType so the slot's value can be Append'd directly to the
709	// typed output column.
710	func newAggSlot(fn AggFunc, inputIsFloat, isTagTarget bool, mode AggMode) (aggSlot, error) {
711		// AggCountDistinct bypasses the Number-parameterized Map/Reduce
712		// dispatch below entirely: its accumulator (aggregation.Distinct) is
713		// not generic over int64/float64, since the target may be a
714		// string/bytes tag. The liaison never constructs a distinct slot — it
715		// combines already-local-distinct partials via ordinary AggSum (design
716		// §7.4, "local distinct, global SUM") — so AggModeReduce here is a
717		// producer/planner bug, not a data error.
718		if fn == AggCountDistinct {
719			if mode == AggModeReduce {
720				return aggSlot{}, fmt.Errorf("vectorized.measure: AggCountDistinct is never reduced directly — the liaison combines local distinct counts via AggSum")
721			}
722			return aggSlot{fn: fn, distinct: aggregation.NewDistinct()}, nil
723		}
724		af, modelErr := toModelAggFunc(fn)
725		if modelErr != nil {
726			return aggSlot{}, modelErr
727		}
728		slot := aggSlot{fn: fn, inputIsFloat: inputIsFloat}
729		// SUM/MIN/MAX/COUNT follow the input type to match the row path, whose
730		// aggregation.NewMap[int64] / [float64] is dispatched on the field's
731		// declared type in pkg/query/logical/measure/measure_plan_aggregation.go
732		// (FIELD_TYPE_INT → int64; FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT → float64). COUNT is
733		// included: the row path's countFunc[N] is parameterized by N and
734		// ToFieldValue[N] emits FieldValue_Int / FieldValue_Float by N, so
735		// COUNT on a float field must emit a float (e.g. float_top_count).
736		//
737		// MEAN over a TAG forces a float64 accumulator (design §6 — "MEAN over
738		// an INT tag yields float64"): there is no FLOAT tag type, so an int64
739		// accumulator would silently truncate. fold already reads an int64
740		// input column and converts to float64 before feeding floatMap.In, so
741		// this is safe. MEAN over a FIELD is unchanged (still follows
742		// inputIsFloat) — AggModeMap's int64 sum/count partial for an INT field
743		// is pinned by TestBatchAggregation_AggModeMap_MeanEmitsValueAndCount;
744		// widening it is a separate, pre-existing correctness question outside
745		// this issue's scope.
746		useFloat := inputIsFloat || (fn == AggMean && isTagTarget)
747		if mode == AggModeReduce {
748			if useFloat {
749				r, reduceErr := aggregation.NewReduce[float64](af)
750				if reduceErr != nil {
751					return aggSlot{}, reduceErr
752				}
753				slot.floatReduce = r
754			} else {
755				r, reduceErr := aggregation.NewReduce[int64](af)
756				if reduceErr != nil {
757					return aggSlot{}, reduceErr
758				}
759				slot.intReduce = r
760			}
761			return slot, nil
762		}
763		if useFloat {
764			m, mapErr := aggregation.NewMap[float64](af)
765			if mapErr != nil {
766				return aggSlot{}, mapErr
767			}
768			slot.floatMap = m
769		} else {
770			m, mapErr := aggregation.NewMap[int64](af)
771			if mapErr != nil {
772				return aggSlot{}, mapErr
773			}
774			slot.intMap = m
775		}
776		return slot, nil
777	}

779	// write emits the slot's reduced value to the typed output column.
780	func (s *aggSlot) write(col vectorized.Column) {
781		if s.distinct != nil {
782			col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(s.distinct.Val())
783			return
784		}
785		if s.intMap != nil {
786			col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(s.intMap.Val())
787			return
788		}
789		col.(*vectorized.TypedColumn[float64]).Append(s.floatMap.Val())
790	}

792	// writePartial emits the slot's Partial() to the AggModeMap output. The
793	// Value lands at out.Columns[valueIdx]; when countIdx >= 0 (MEAN only)
794	// the Count sidecar lands at out.Columns[countIdx]. The count column has
795	// the same numeric type as the value column (aggregation.Partial[N] uses
796	// the same N for both), matching the row path's per-N FieldValue oneof
797	// (FIELD_TYPE_INT → int64, FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT → float64).
798	func (s *aggSlot) writePartial(out *vectorized.RecordBatch, valueIdx, countIdx int) {
799		if s.distinct != nil {
800			// The local distinct count is the whole partial — no count
801			// sidecar (aggHasCount is false for AggCountDistinct specs,
802			// unlike MEAN's sum+count shape; see buildAggOutputLayout).
803			out.Columns[valueIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(s.distinct.Val())
804			return
805		}
806		if s.intMap != nil {
807			p := s.intMap.Partial()
808			out.Columns[valueIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(p.Value)
809			if countIdx >= 0 {
810				out.Columns[countIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[int64]).Append(p.Count)
811			}
812			return
813		}
814		p := s.floatMap.Partial()
815		out.Columns[valueIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[float64]).Append(p.Value)
816		if countIdx >= 0 {
817			out.Columns[countIdx].(*vectorized.TypedColumn[float64]).Append(p.Count)
818		}
819	}

840	// aggOutputLayout captures the AggModeAll / AggModeMap output-batch layout
841	// produced by buildAggOutputLayout. It is plumbed onto BatchAggregation so
842	// emitGroupRow does no per-row schema walking.
843	type aggOutputLayout struct {
844		schema *vectorized.BatchSchema
845		// aggOutOffsets[i] is the output-batch column index of the i-th agg's
846		// VALUE column. When aggHasCount[i] is true (AggModeMap + AggMean only),
847		// the agg's count sidecar lives at aggOutOffsets[i]+1.
848		aggOutOffsets []int
849		// aggHasCount[i] is true iff the i-th agg emits a Partial.Count sidecar
850		// — i.e. AggModeMap + AggMean. Other modes/funcs are false.
851		aggHasCount []bool
852		// outputShardIdx is the output-batch column index of the leading
853		// RoleShardID column. -1 in AggModeAll (no shard column emitted);
854		// 0 in AggModeMap (the partial batch always carries shard id first).
855		outputShardIdx int
856		// outputTimestampIdx is the output-batch column index of the RoleTimestamp
857		// column re-emitted for a time-bucketed aggregation (design §7.2's
858		// conditional D2 reversal). -1 when the aggregation is not bucketed —
859		// the unbucketed case still drops the timestamp entirely, unchanged.
860		outputTimestampIdx int
861		// tagOutOffset is the output-batch column index where the tag columns
862		// begin: 0 in AggModeAll, plus 1 for a leading shard-id column (AggModeMap)
863		// and plus 1 more for a leading bucket timestamp column (if bucketed).
864		tagOutOffset int
865	}

867	// buildAggOutputLayout derives the output-batch ColumnDef list AND the
868	// per-agg / shard-id / timestamp index bookkeeping for a given (input
869	// schema, tag indices, agg specs, mode, bucket index). It is the sole place
870	// that decides Map-mode's shard-id-first + MEAN-emits-two-columns layout,
871	// plus the bucketed case's leading timestamp column, so emit-time code can
872	// just consult precomputed offsets. bucketIdx is the input-schema index of
873	// the bucket key column, or -1 when the aggregation is not bucketed.
874	func buildAggOutputLayout(
875		input *vectorized.BatchSchema, tagIndices []int, aggs []AggSpec, mode AggMode, bucketIdx int,
876	) aggOutputLayout {
877		// Worst-case capacity: shard-id (1) + timestamp (1) + tags + 2 per agg.
878		defs := make([]vectorized.ColumnDef, 0, 2+len(tagIndices)+2*len(aggs))
879		layout := aggOutputLayout{
880			aggOutOffsets:      make([]int, len(aggs)),
881			aggHasCount:        make([]bool, len(aggs)),
882			outputShardIdx:     -1,
883			outputTimestampIdx: -1,
884		}
885		if mode == AggModeMap {
886			defs = append(defs, vectorized.ColumnDef{
887				Role: vectorized.RoleShardID,
888				Name: shardIDOutputName,
889				Type: vectorized.ColumnTypeInt64,
890			})
891			layout.outputShardIdx = 0
892		}
893		if bucketIdx >= 0 {
894			layout.outputTimestampIdx = len(defs)
895			defs = append(defs, vectorized.ColumnDef{Role: vectorized.RoleTimestamp, Type: vectorized.ColumnTypeInt64})
896		}
897		layout.tagOutOffset = len(defs)
898		for _, ti := range tagIndices {
899			defs = append(defs, input.Columns[ti])
900		}
901		for i, agg := range aggs {
902			layout.aggOutOffsets[i] = len(defs)
903			inputDef := input.Columns[agg.InputCol]
904			valueType := aggOutputType(inputDef.Type, agg.Func, inputDef.Role == vectorized.RoleTag)
905			defs = append(defs, vectorized.ColumnDef{
906				Role: vectorized.RoleField,
907				Name: agg.Output,
908				Type: valueType,
909			})
910			if mode == AggModeMap && agg.Func == AggMean {
911				layout.aggHasCount[i] = true
912				defs = append(defs, vectorized.ColumnDef{
913					Role: vectorized.RoleField,
914					Name: agg.Output + meanCountSuffix,
915					Type: valueType,
916				})
917			}
918		}
919		layout.schema = vectorized.NewBatchSchema(defs)
920		return layout
921	}

936	// aggOutputType maps (input type, agg func, target kind) to the output
937	// column type. SUM/MIN/MAX preserve the input type so vec egress emits the
938	// same FieldValue oneof variant the row path uses: the row path's
939	// accumulator and ToFieldValue[N] are dispatched on the field's declared
940	// type (FIELD_TYPE_INT → int64 → FieldValue_Int; FIELD_TYPE_FLOAT →
941	// float64 → FieldValue_Float; see measure_plan_aggregation.go and
942	// pkg/query/aggregation). Two functions diverge from "preserve input type":
943	//
944	//   - MEAN over a tag outputs float64 — matches newAggSlot's isTagTarget
945	//     float64 accumulator (design §6). MEAN over a field preserves the
946	//     input type unchanged (see newAggSlot for why).
947	//   - COUNT preserves int64/float64 (unchanged, including the row-path
948	//     quirk of a float count over a float field) but forces int64 for any
949	//     other input — string/bytes tag columns (design §6) have no numeric
950	//     representation to preserve.
951	func aggOutputType(in vectorized.ColumnType, fn AggFunc, isTagTarget bool) vectorized.ColumnType {
952		if in == vectorized.ColumnTypeFieldValue {
953			return vectorized.ColumnTypeInt64
954		}
955		switch fn {
956		case AggMean:
957			if isTagTarget {
958				return vectorized.ColumnTypeFloat64
959			}
960			return in
961		case AggCount:
962			if in == vectorized.ColumnTypeFloat64 {
963				return vectorized.ColumnTypeFloat64
964			}
965			return vectorized.ColumnTypeInt64
966		case AggCountDistinct:
967			// A distinct count is always an integer, regardless of the
968			// target's type — unlike AggCount, there is no float-input
969			// carry-through quirk to preserve here.
970			return vectorized.ColumnTypeInt64
971		default:
972			return in
973		}
974	}

35	// BatchGroupBy is a BreakerOperator that partitions input rows by the values
36	// of one or more key columns. Output preserves the input schema; rows are
37	// emitted in group-insertion order, with all rows of the first group flushed
38	// before the next group begins.
39	//
40	// When firstOnly is set the operator keeps only the first-seen row of each
41	// group and drops subsequent rows. This reproduces the row path's raw
42	// GroupBy egress: the row aggregator wraps every group in a single
43	// InternalDataPoint slice and banyand/query/processor.go reads only
44	// current[0] per Next, so a raw GroupBy surfaces exactly one row (the
45	// first-seen) per group in group-insertion order.
46	//
47	// Memory accounting follows a pessimistic-reserve, refund-unused pattern:
48	//
49	//   - entrySize is the per-new-group bucket overhead.
50	//   - rowSize  is the per-row data cost (independent of group identity).
51	//   - On Consume, reserve worst-case = activeRows * (entrySize + rowSize).
52	//   - After actual consumption, refund (worstCaseNewGroups - actualNewGroups) * entrySize.
53	//
54	// Close releases every outstanding reservation, even mid-Consume cancellations.
55	type BatchGroupBy struct {
56		schema       *vectorized.BatchSchema
57		pool         *vectorized.BatchPool
58		tracker      *vectorized.MemoryTracker
59		span         *query.Span
60		groups       map[uint64][]*groupBucket
61		insertion    []*groupBucket
62		keyIndices   []int
63		keyEncBuf    []byte // scratch buffer reused across rows during Consume
64		entrySize    int64
65		rowSize      int64
66		reserved     int64
67		rowsIn       int64
68		rowsOut      int64
69		batchSize    int
70		cursorBucket int
71		cursorRow    int
72		closed       bool
73		firstOnly    bool
74	}
75	
76	type groupBucket struct {
77		cols     []vectorized.Column
78		keyBytes []byte
79	}

81	// NewBatchGroupBy constructs a BatchGroupBy.
82	//
83	//   - entrySize: per-new-group bucket overhead.
84	//   - rowSize:   per-row data cost.
85	//
86	// Pass rowSize=0 to charge only per-new-group; pass entrySize=0 to charge
87	// only per-row.
88	func NewBatchGroupBy(
89		schema *vectorized.BatchSchema, keyIndices []int,
90		pool *vectorized.BatchPool, batchSize int,
91		tracker *vectorized.MemoryTracker, entrySize, rowSize int64,
92	) *BatchGroupBy {
93		return &BatchGroupBy{
94			schema:     schema,
95			keyIndices: slices.Clone(keyIndices),
96			pool:       pool,
97			batchSize:  batchSize,
98			tracker:    tracker,
99			entrySize:  entrySize,
100			rowSize:    rowSize,

137	// Consume reserves the worst-case bytes for new groups + per-row cost,
138	// accumulates rows into per-group buckets, then refunds the unused reservation.
139	func (g *BatchGroupBy) Consume(_ context.Context, b *vectorized.RecordBatch) error {
140		active, activeErr := activeIndices(b)
141		if activeErr != nil {
142			return activeErr
143		}
144		n := int64(len(active))
145		if g.span != nil {
146			g.rowsIn += n
147		}
148		estBytes := n*g.entrySize + n*g.rowSize
149		if estBytes > 0 {
150			if reserveErr := g.tracker.Reserve(estBytes); reserveErr != nil {
151				return fmt.Errorf("group-by memory budget exceeded: %w", reserveErr)
152			}
153			g.reserved += estBytes
154		}
155		actualBytes := g.consumeRows(b, active)
156		if actualBytes < estBytes {
157			refund := estBytes - actualBytes
158			g.tracker.Release(refund)
159			g.reserved -= refund
160		}
161		return nil
162	}

164	func (g *BatchGroupBy) consumeRows(b *vectorized.RecordBatch, active []uint16) int64 {
165		var newGroups int64
166		var copiedRows int64
167		for _, rowIdx := range active {
168			bucket, isNew := g.findOrCreate(b, int(rowIdx))
169			if isNew {
170				newGroups++
171			}
172			if g.firstOnly && !isNew {
173				// Raw GroupBy keeps only the first-seen row per group;
174				// drop every later row in the same group.
175				continue
176			}
177			for colIdx, srcCol := range b.Columns {
178				copyOneValue(bucket.cols[colIdx], srcCol, int(rowIdx))
179			}
180			copiedRows++
181		}
182		return newGroups*g.entrySize + copiedRows*g.rowSize
183	}

185	// findOrCreate locates the bucket for the row's key, creating it if absent.
186	// Hash collisions are resolved by linear scan over the bucket chain — the
187	// keyBytes are compared exactly, so two distinct keys that hash to the same
188	// uint64 still map to different buckets.
189	func (g *BatchGroupBy) findOrCreate(b *vectorized.RecordBatch, rowIdx int) (*groupBucket, bool) {
190		g.keyEncBuf = g.encodeKey(g.keyEncBuf[:0], b, rowIdx)
191		h := hashKey(g.keyEncBuf)
192		candidates := g.groups[h]
193		for _, candidate := range candidates {
194			if bytes.Equal(candidate.keyBytes, g.keyEncBuf) {
195				return candidate, false
196			}
197		}
198		bucket := newGroupBucket(g.schema)
199		bucket.keyBytes = slices.Clone(g.keyEncBuf)
200		g.groups[h] = append(candidates, bucket)
201		g.insertion = append(g.insertion, bucket)
202		return bucket, true
203	}

208	// NextBatch emits accumulated rows in group-insertion order, paginated by
209	// batchSize. Returns (nil, nil) when all groups are drained.
210	func (g *BatchGroupBy) NextBatch(_ context.Context) (*vectorized.RecordBatch, error) {
211		if g.cursorBucket >= len(g.insertion) {
212			return nil, nil
213		}
214		out := g.pool.Get()
215		for out.Len < g.batchSize && g.cursorBucket < len(g.insertion) {
216			bucket := g.insertion[g.cursorBucket]
217			bucketLen := bucket.cols[0].Len()
218			for g.cursorRow < bucketLen && out.Len < g.batchSize {
219				for colIdx := range out.Columns {
220					copyOneValue(out.Columns[colIdx], bucket.cols[colIdx], g.cursorRow)
221				}
222				out.Len++
223				g.cursorRow++
224				if g.span != nil {
225					g.rowsOut++
226				}
227			}
228			if g.cursorRow >= bucketLen {
229				g.cursorBucket++
230				g.cursorRow = 0
231			}
232		}
233		if out.Len == 0 {
234			g.pool.Put(out)
235			return nil, nil
236		}
237		return out, nil
238	}

240	// Close releases every outstanding memory reservation. Idempotent.
241	func (g *BatchGroupBy) Close() error {
242		if g.closed {
243			return nil
244		}
245		g.closed = true
246		if g.reserved > 0 {
247			g.tracker.Release(g.reserved)
248			g.reserved = 0
